nameEn: Tangent Essays 01 - Out of a Grail the Mountains Sail
descriptionEn:
This book is the first volume in the Tangent Essays publishing series. Presented bilingually in Chinese and English, it brings together ten carefully edited essays on architecture by the Tangent team. Rooted in a belief in the essay as a form, contributors from diverse humanistic fields wander across architecture, literature, history, design, science, and art, attending thoughtfully to the chance encounters and affinities that arise between things. 

120 × 185 mm, 388 pages, ISBN 978-1-80377-830-3

"On Experience and Process”. 
DEMO issue 7 is out now!

360’s curatorial team emphasized for 2022’s Award360 Exhibition to be accessible, visible, and interactive. In response to this appeal, we aim to invite the public to experience the redesign of daily life, interacting with these objects with a relaxed mind.

DPi collaborated with the 360 curatorial team to design a series of visuals, displays, signage, and motion properties. The visual identity of the exhibition revolves around the characteristics of “post-it notes”, focusing on their light and pleasant feeling. The various outputs were united through visual components such as shape variations, a common color palette, and simple typography.

inlabism is an experimental finishes brand, with a focus on materials, structures, functions and forms, combining reality and imagination, researching the multiple experiences of individual living environments.

The visual identity is centered on the [cube]—the core of the brand spirit that is calm, restrained, and tolerant of diversity—and incorporates the layout form of the brand product number "0 0000 00" into the visual system. The brand logomark, products and visual system are in contrast to each other, forming a strong and calm brand visual impression.

KAIPUU is a boutique hotel brand dedicated to offering diverse life philosophies and high quality experiences, centering on the idea of “A New Philosophy of Living in the Moment”.

KAIPUU originated in the city of Quanzhou, Fujian province, China. The brand’s visual design is rooted in the local cultural characteristics of southern Fujian, showcasing its ancient house architecture, fishing village culture, as well as tea culture. The design transforms these characteristics into visual language, and applies them to graphics, images, and structures. It presents modern form of expression that highlights geopolitics and humanity. Meanwhile, we designed a guiding system for both KAIPUU’s ON THE REEF and BELFRY hotels, launched in the autumn of 2023.

Founded in 2013, Songmont seeks a balance between functionality and aesthetics. Exploring the relationship between people and objects, the company is committed to creating women’s bag designs that resonate with the idea of “self-knowledge of nature”. Cooperating with the Songmont team, DPi designed a visual identity based on the idea of “restraint design”. We integrate and develop product-coding and visual system, packaging, as well as brand and digital strategy.

Invited to design the exhibition visuals and display for Songmont’s 10th-anniversary art/craft exhibition.

We took the brand pattern as the anchor point and created the interactive relationship, covering/wrapping/enclosing, between the wooden frame and the fabric to echo the craftsmanship and historical retrospection tone of the exhibition and return to the brand's oriental view of nature.

Inspired by daily life, world culture, and craft art, xiaonan STUDIO combines the craftsmanship and materials of art production with jewelry making in order to produce a young jewelry brand made for everyday wear. 
The brand’s visual identity and packaging refer to the contrast and balance of roughness and delicacy, modernity and classic.

Exhibition Flyer designed for Scale, Space, Smooth Transit.

Folding, attracting, and floating on the surface.
Brand reader designed for herbeast, a local sustainable beauty and lifestyle brand in China.

HOBOJUNGLE is a catering store under HOBO+, with the aim of becoming tents scattered in the busy city, bringing people together unexpectedly to celebrate life together. The visual language is centered around a tent-like arrow, which functions to point out directions in the visual system, keeping it simple but joyful.
Opening poster produced for HOBOJUNGLE.

putiputi is a flower subscription brand advocating the life philosophy of "taking flowers as a medium to accompany our life in a natural way".

The visual language depicts the vitality and imagination of nature in a warm and peaceful tone. Abstract graphics and rich visual layers give the brand a vivid and poetic visual impression.

HOBO+ is a brand centered around the idea of being “on the road”, operating various brands that relate to life and travel, including hotels, groceries, and catering. Its visual language was inspired by the hobo sign, which is simple, rustic, yet powerful.

The visual identity is deliberately “under-designed” while keeping the design simple and straightforward; this aims to bring accessibility and openness, encouraging users to leave artificial labels.

Wallpaper* 卷宗 (Juanzong) celebrates its 5th-anniversary campaign, themed “Join Forces”. Its design deconstructs the brand icon, “*”, and uses the Roman numeral “V” as a center element. It derives a series of graphics through copying, 3D planning, model rendering, etc. to facilitate its usage on different platforms and media.

“Jiaocao” refers to the common method of porcelain packaging, which connected people, nature, and porcelain-making tradition together. XU’s collection series traces back to “Jiaocao”, rewrapping its products with ceramic materials to preserve the history and memory of “Jiaocao”. The packaging design of this work collection is inspired by the structure of “Jiaocao".

The “treasure bottle”, a element often seen in different religions, can bring blessings of peace and completeness. XU uses the idea of this “treasure bottle” to send blessings to people in the new year.

The theme of the 2nd issue of “Hylla Journal” is “Garden”. By compiling a variety of gardens from different times and places around the world, the journal responds to the complexity of the human inner world, as well as its relationship to the outside world.
The theme of the 6th issue of DEMO is "On Residence and Meaning".

Media Art 21 is a Chinese-English bilingual database-driven online resource initiated and produced by the Institute of Sci-Tech Art at the Central Academy of Fine Arts in collaboration with the Art + Design Initiative at University of California, Berkeley.

Tangent Essays is an online publishing platform that periodically features writings about architecture. 
Tangent Essays promises literary quality rich in vitality and levity. The three graphics are an imaginary description of Tangent Essay’s writings — “a snowball, rolling tangentially”, “a kite, towing tangentially”, and “Apollo 8 completing the earth-moon transfer”. The three graphics are made into real kites to connect with the real world. 

Further Reading

Tangent Essays is an online and paper-based publishing platform that periodically features writings about architecture. The site communicates the experience of interacting with typography and explores the visual construction of massive archived materials, which was constructed as a website with distinctive expressions.

Ridge-Beam Architecture Studio is an architecture practice that seeks to reinterpret the modest and pragmatic nature of ‘architecture’  from both anthropological and sociological perspectives.

The design of its logo is composed of an invisible horizontal line by rotating the letter “A”, while also interpreting the Chinese character “棟”, which translates to ridge beam. The visual identity system is built on a grid system based on a fixed-size logo.

DEMO is a biannual pan-design review journal, first of its kind - born and raised in China but constantly tracking the global trend. The journal’s content covers in-depth interviews with top design talents and industry insiders, field researches in various forms on unique topics, and above all, findings of DEMO as a design research workshop over the period of half a year. By observing China design from both local and international perspectives, investigating the features of design in different context of history, pop culture and our everyday life; DEMO tries to spark open discussions of design in China and its value.
XU is an artistic brand that tells stories through objects, whose theme consists of the research on history of creation and cultural phenomena.

XU Season01 is a book exhibiting artist Hao Zhenhan’s observation photography in Northwest India’s Kumartuli village. The book also documents experiments on soil and fabrics in Jingdezhen, showcasing the creative process of XU’s first season of works.

Hylla Journal is a magazine published by HYLLA 物与岚. The journal explores the symbiotic relationship between humankind and nature from the perspectives of life, art, design, and history.

In the design of this book, we think about “relationships" between big/small, hard/soft, contemporary/classic, and individual/collective.

The first issue was on the topic of trees.

cococean is a coconut drink brand that encourages joyful and healthy living.

Considering each of its products, we created the brand identity as a visual system consisting of coming drawings, echoing cococean’s story through a light and joyful mood.
CHUSHAN is an art education platform developed by the TIAC International Art Education Group that focuses on traditional painting and sculpture using different media both online and offline.

I Might Know You Before is an exhibition of images that explores new possibilities of communication. 

The visual design of the exhibition takes the idea of “communication” into consideration; a text-only poster would be made into a packet for the audience to put in pages/images that they chose. Instead of a booklet, the poster becomes a key medium for the audience to communicate with the artists.
LIANG is a housewares brand that brings the spirit and rituals of objects to life. The visual identity presents shapes of objects at different time frames in the form of shadow.

nameEn: Send Snow Sound To a Person You Like
descriptionEn:
Send Snow Sound To A Person You Like is a collection of “snow” themed bullet journal products, launched by the life-creative brand Flaming.

A range of visual combinations, materials, and printing were used in order to express the comprehensive impression of snow.
HULU LAB aims to diversify and revamp the modern image of traditional Chinese culture through the experimentation of various creative forms.

A magic-spell candle that FOR SAMPLE in its collaboration with OLGA-goosecandle.

Light the candle, and the spell appears.
